courses.title: Blockbuster 4K: The AI Filmmaking Pipeline
courses.description: One 40-minute tutorial — scripting, asset creation, and scene-by-scene prompt engineering — chaptered into sections you can follow along with, shot by shot.

courses.title: Build an Ultra-Realistic Short Film in 4K
courses.description: A 33-minute director's masterclass. A football drama built shot by shot with Claude Fable 5 and Seedance 2.0 4K.

courses.title: Add AI VFX to Real Footage
courses.description: Turn footage you shot on a normal camera into cinematic 4K VFX with Seedance 2.0 — world swaps, creatures, and full handheld showcase shots, one sentence at a time.

courses.title: Make an AI Animated Short
courses.description: Build one animated story across eight distinct visual worlds, from concept and scene design to a finished short.

courses.title: How to evaluate AI filmmaking demos
courses.description: Learn to evaluate AI filmmaking demos by examining camera movement, performance, continuity, and delivery constraints.

courses.title: The 3-Step Realistic AI Ad Workflow
courses.description: Build a fully AI-generated commercial from scratch — lock every asset, turn a script into a connected shotlist with a Claude skill, then generate and stitch the final scenes.

courses.title: Build an AI Ad Agency with Claude + Higgsfield
courses.description: Research a niche, shape an offer, build a varied ad portfolio, and test a small client pipeline with Claude and Higgsfield.

courses.title: Seedance 4K: Cinematic Realism
courses.description: Test Seedance 4K across hyper-detailed realism, wide crowd shots, real-footage VFX, animation, ads, games, and fast action.

courses.title: Build a Brand's Visuals with AI
courses.description: Create a complete AI brand visual system, from the brand and products to try-ons, ads, social content, TV spots, and packaging.

courses.title: Make a Cinematic Ad End-to-End
courses.description: Build a cinematic AI ad from reusable assets and a prompting framework through a 12-scene story, winning beat, and pack shot.

courses.title: Automate a Faceless Niche Channel
courses.description: Build a faceless explainer channel with live research, monetizable scripts, video generation, localization, voice, packaging, and a release plan.

courses.title: Build a Faceless Channel
courses.description: Build and test a faceless AI channel by connecting Claude and Higgsfield, writing a script, generating a video, packaging it, and reading early results.

courses.title: Mix AI with Real Footage
courses.description: Combine AI edits with real footage by removing or adding elements, changing wardrobe and backgrounds, building transitions, reframing, and upscaling.

courses.title: Build 3D Games with MCP
courses.description: Build and publish three no-code 3D game prototypes with an MCP-connected workflow, then compare output, cost, and early marketplace results.

courses.title: Direct a cinematic AI car commercial
courses.description: Build a cinematic car commercial from reusable assets, controlled iterations, and continuity-aware editing.

courses.title: Direct AI fight scenes through controlled iteration
courses.description: Build reusable action assets, diagnose failed generations, and direct scale, transformations, impacts, and cinematic coverage without losing geography or physics.

courses.title: AI Creation: First Steps
courses.description: Follow the original seven-lesson course, from your first video and working with an assistant to product ads, asset creation, camera direction, and your own scene.
